prompt: I want to ___ a huge thank you to the bread shop owner down the street for keeping my lost green bird safe inside a fruit box.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении 'say thank you' (сказать спасибо) используется глагол say.

prompt: Words cannot ___ how grateful I am to the kind stranger who tied my dropped house keys to a bright ribbon at the bus shelter.
explanation_ru: В идиоматическом выражении 'words cannot say' (словами не передать) употребляется глагол say.

prompt: Amir, I have to ___ you the truth before you open your spice jar—it still smells faintly of roasted cumin, though I am so grateful for your cast-iron skillet!
explanation_ru: В устойчивом сочетании 'tell someone the truth' (сказать кому-либо правду) требуется глагол tell.

prompt: I am writing to ___ highly of the officer who spotted my dropped passport near the tram stop and sprinted half a block to return it before my bus departed.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении 'speak highly of someone' (хорошо отзываться о ком-либо) используется глагол speak.

prompt: When I ___ to friends about how twelve of you showed up in raincoats to rescue our cherry harvest before the hailstorm, I still get emotional.
explanation_ru: Для неформального обсуждения чего-либо с друзьями используется конструкция 'talk to someone about something' (говорить с кем-либо о чём-либо).

prompt: Auntie, I just realized I left my damp umbrella in your hallway! Thank you so much for the homemade rice balls—they are saving me on this long train ride. I also wanted to ___ sorry for rushing out so quickly this morning.
explanation_ru: В устойчивом выражении «say sorry» (извиниться) используется глагол say.

prompt: After the credits rolled, Kasia and Jacek spent half an hour ___ over whether the surprise twist at the end made logical sense or simply rushed the final ten minutes.
explanation_ru: Для описания оживленного обсуждения или спора («talk over» — обсуждать) используется глагол talk.

prompt: When the grilled sardines arrived twenty minutes late, the waitress ___ the couple how sorry she was and brought a complimentary bowl of warm olives to thank them for their patience.
explanation_ru: После глагола tell сразу указывается адресат (told the couple), в отличие от say.

prompt: Reaching for the last cheese biscuit at the same moment, Adam and Freya laughed and started ___ about how they both knew the host from completely different jobs.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk естественно сочетается с предлогом about (talk about — болтать, говорить о чём-то).

prompt: While trying on four pairs of round glasses, Nadia and the shop worker ___ happily about summer gardens and how easy it is to lose reading glasses in the kitchen.
explanation_ru: Для непринужденной беседы на общие темы с предлогом about используется глагол talk (talked about).

prompt: Over afternoon tea, Paul and Rita said warmly about their favourite historic bridges and joked about how many stone stairs they had climbed since morning.
answer: Over afternoon tea, Paul and Rita talked warmly about their favourite historic bridges and joked about how many stone stairs they had climbed since morning.
accepted_answers: Over afternoon tea, Paul and Rita talked warmly about their favourite historic bridges and joked about how many stone stairs they had climbed since morning.
Over afternoon tea, Paul and Rita spoke warmly about their favourite historic bridges and joked about how many stone stairs they had climbed since morning.
explanation_ru: Глагол say не используется для описания беседы с предлогом about; здесь нужен глагол talked (или spoke).

prompt: While waiting for the tiny conveyor toaster to finish, Olga and Paul talked about quiet beaches and joked about how burnt hotel toast always smells.
answer: While waiting for the tiny conveyor toaster to finish, Olga and Paul talked about quiet beaches and joked about how burnt hotel toast always smells.
accepted_answers: While waiting for the tiny conveyor toaster to finish, Olga and Paul talked about quiet beaches and joked about how burnt hotel toast always smells.
explanation_ru: Предложение составлено верно: для описания непринужденного разговора используется форма talked about.

prompt: Ten minutes before his interview, Ravi chatted with the receptionist about the giant cactus on her desk, and she casually said him that the manager loves short, direct answers.
answer: Ten minutes before his interview, Ravi chatted with the receptionist about the giant cactus on her desk, and she casually told him that the manager loves short, direct answers.
accepted_answers: Ten minutes before his interview, Ravi chatted with the receptionist about the giant cactus on her desk, and she casually told him that the manager loves short, direct answers.
Ten minutes before his interview, Ravi chatted with the receptionist about the giant cactus on her desk, and she casually said to him that the manager loves short, direct answers.
explanation_ru: После глагола say нельзя ставить прямое дополнение без предлога to; правильно использовать told him (или said to him).

prompt: Resting their sore feet by the fountain, Samir and Elena told about how huge the gallery was and how they always spent too long in the gift shop.
answer: Resting their sore feet by the fountain, Samir and Elena talked about how huge the gallery was and how they always spent too long in the gift shop.
accepted_answers: Resting their sore feet by the fountain, Samir and Elena talked about how huge the gallery was and how they always spent too long in the gift shop.
Resting their sore feet by the fountain, Samir and Elena spoke about how huge the gallery was and how they always spent too long in the gift shop.
explanation_ru: Глагол tell требует указания собеседника и не употребляется в значении «беседовать о чём-либо» (нужно talked about или spoke about).

prompt: While waiting for sparkling water, Eva and Amir talked about the colourful stage costumes and laughed about how neither of them had understood the first act without subtitles.
answer: While waiting for sparkling water, Eva and Amir talked about the colourful stage costumes and laughed about how neither of them had understood the first act without subtitles.
accepted_answers: While waiting for sparkling water, Eva and Amir talked about the colourful stage costumes and laughed about how neither of them had understood the first act without subtitles.
explanation_ru: Ошибок нет: глагол talked правильно использован с предлогом about для описания разговора двух людей.

prompt: Under the eucalyptus tree, Salma and Paul were saying about their heavy school backpacks and muddy trainers.
answer: Under the eucalyptus tree, Salma and Paul were talking about their heavy school backpacks and muddy trainers.
accepted_answers: Under the eucalyptus tree, Salma and Paul were talking about their heavy school backpacks and muddy trainers.
Under the eucalyptus tree, Salma and Paul were speaking about their heavy school backpacks and muddy trainers.
Under the eucalyptus tree, Salma and Paul were chatting about their heavy school backpacks and muddy trainers.
explanation_ru: Для дружеской беседы на какую-либо тему используется глагол talk (talk about), а не say.

prompt: Between afternoon lectures, Mei and Henrik have a friendly chat about the snow outside and the bad coffee in their university departments.
options: Mei and Henrik told about the snowy weather and their terrible department coffee.
Mei and Henrik said about the snowy weather and their terrible department coffee.
Mei and Henrik talked about the snowy weather and their terrible department coffee.
Mei and Henrik spoke the snowy weather and their terrible department coffee.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk (talk about) лучше всего подходит для непринужденного обсуждения общих тем.

prompt: While waiting behind a slow card machine in the shop, Grace and a retired teacher chat about mystery novels and tiny book print.
options: Grace and the retired teacher said about mystery writers while waiting in line.
Grace and the retired teacher told about mystery writers while waiting in line.
Grace and the retired teacher talked about mystery writers while waiting in line.
Grace and the retired teacher spoke mystery writers while waiting in line.
explanation_ru: Для обозначения дружеского разговора на какую-либо тему используется глагол talk с предлогом about.

prompt: Before their morning run, Petra and Yusuf chat about waking up early and agree not to run too fast at the start.
options: Petra and Yusuf talked about waking up early before the run.
Petra and Yusuf told about waking up early before the run.
Petra and Yusuf said about waking up early before the run.
Petra and Yusuf spoke waking up early before the run.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk about используется, когда люди беседуют и обмениваются мнениями на какую-то тему.

prompt: At the repair shop, Sofia and the clerk share funny stories about dropping phones into cereal bowls and forgetting passwords.
options: Sofia and the clerk said funny stories about broken phones.
Sofia and the clerk told funny stories about broken phones.
Sofia and the clerk talked funny stories about broken phones.
Sofia and the clerk spoke funny stories about broken phones.
explanation_ru: С существительным stories (рассказывать истории) используется устойчивое сочетание tell stories.

prompt: Stuck in evening traffic, Nadia and the taxi driver have a friendly chat about football scores, hot weather, and a faster road over the bridge.
options: Nadia and the driver told about football scores and the weather in traffic.
Nadia and the driver said about football scores and the weather in traffic.
Nadia and the driver talked about football scores and the weather in traffic.
Nadia and the driver spoke football scores and the weather in traffic.
explanation_ru: Для непринужденной беседы на разные темы используется глагол talk (talk about).

prompt: In the airport security line, David and Priya (say / talk) about expensive coffee and bad sleep on night flights.
explanation_ru: Глагол talk (talk about) используется для обозначения разговора или беседы на определенную тему.

prompt: Outside the exam hall, Clara and Liam (tell / talk) about the rain and their lucky pens before the doors open.
explanation_ru: Для дружеского обсуждения темы (talk about) используется глагол talk, так как tell требует прямого дополнения (кому).

prompt: Under the small bus shelter, Ravi and Olga (say / talk) about the sudden spring storm and laugh about their sunglasses.
explanation_ru: Когда люди беседуют друг с другом на какую-либо тему, используется глагол talk с предлогом about.

prompt: Stuck in the lift, Hana and the director politely (tell / talk) about umbrellas and weekend bakeries instead of the late meeting.
explanation_ru: Для вежливой светской беседы на нейтральные темы используется глагол talk (talk about).
